comment: Forced block starts. The lifter starts a block at each address, so the dispatcher can run m.hooks before it (docs/stage1-design.md). Hooks may be registered only at lifted block starts; to hook a new address, add it here and re-run lift/lifter.py.

hooks.name: rng_store
hooks.what: RNG store; eax = drawn value, caller = r32(esp+4) - 5

hooks.name: tick_start
hooks.what: first instruction of a logic tick

hooks.name: frame_entry
hooks.what: per-frame function called by the main loop at 0x4010F7

hooks.name: frame_body
hooks.what: frame body, after [0x991F6C] = esp; runs frame actions

hooks.name: start_scenario
hooks.what: load target (redirect destination of the load action)
